SUP-ale.zh: 以 Atari 画面驱动游戏动作；原论文也比较通用规划算法，规划范围依赖所选游戏。
SUP-ale.en: Atari screen observations drive game actions. Original paper benchmarks domain-independent planning agents; scope depends on selected game.

SUP-vizdoom.zh: 以第一人称画面执行移动和射击；迷宫场景提供导航与探索任务。
SUP-vizdoom.en: Screen-buffer input and move/shoot actions support first-person visual control. Original maze-navigation scenario supports navigation and exploration studies.

SUP-smac.zh: 各单位依据局部观测独立行动并协同作战；策略标签仅指对固定敌方队伍的战术选择，不代表完整战略运营。
SUP-smac.en: Each unit is an independent agent acting from local observations in cooperative combat. Teams choose tactical combat actions against a fixed opposing team.

SUP-sc2le.zh: 完整对局涉及资源和军事决策及延迟回报；小游戏可分别研究单位选择与控制，不能把二者合成同一任务。
SUP-sc2le.en: Full-game StarCraft II includes resource and military decisions. Main game has delayed credit assignment over thousands of actions. Minigames isolate aspects of unit selection and control.

SUP-textworld.zh: 生成器控制游戏规模与难度，以建立训练和测试集合；文字目标与改变状态的行动序列提供规划研究场景。
SUP-textworld.en: Generator controls game scope and difficulty to construct train/test game sets. Text adventures expose goals and state-changing action sequences.

SUP-babyai.zh: 指令要求按顺序操作网格世界物体；组合式指令支持语言泛化研究，但必须明确数据划分。
SUP-babyai.en: Instructions can require ordered object manipulation in gridworlds. Compositional synthetic instructions support grounded language generalization studies; split must be explicit.

SUP-openspiel.zh: 覆盖完全与不完全信息、零和与一般和博弈，并提供搜索与规划算法。平台本身没有唯一的能力评分协议。
SUP-openspiel.en: Perfect/imperfect-information and zero/general-sum games support strategic decision analysis. Framework includes search and planning algorithms for game trees.

SUP-deepmind-lab.zh: 第一人称三维观测驱动移动与交互；导航任务在受限观测世界中提供探索问题。
SUP-deepmind-lab.en: First-person 3D observations drive movement and interactions. Navigation tasks expose partially observed worlds.

SUP-gvgai.zh: 未见游戏是多游戏竞赛的一部分；规划赛道提供前向模拟，需与只依赖交互学习的赛道区分。
SUP-gvgai.en: Playing previously unseen games is part of the multi-game competition design. Planning tracks provide forward simulation, unlike learning-only tracks.

SUP-coinrun.zh: 固定训练关卡与程序生成测试关卡用于分析过拟合；跳跃和避障属于控制要求。官方测试采样不保证严格排除训练关卡，若需要不重叠测试须另行验证。
SUP-coinrun.en: Fixed training levels and procedurally sampled test levels support overfitting analysis; jumping and obstacle avoidance require control. Official test sampling does not strictly exclude training levels; verify disjointness if required.

SUP-obstacle-tower.zh: 未见的程序生成塔楼用于泛化评估；移动平台、障碍与解谜房间结合时机控制和路线决策。
SUP-obstacle-tower.en: Evaluation uses unseen procedural tower instances. 3D movement, obstacles and moving platforms require timed control. Puzzle rooms and floor navigation combine low-level control with high-level route/task decisions.

SUP-minerl-dataset.zh: 数据中的 Minecraft 任务涉及层级依赖；演示配对观测与人类动作。数据集需配合具体任务及评分协议，不能独立当作能力测验。
SUP-minerl-dataset.en: Related Minecraft tasks have hierarchical dependencies documented by the dataset paper. Demonstrations pair game observations with human actions.

SUP-griddly.zh: 可配置游戏和不同观测方式用于设计受控泛化与观测—动作实验；具体能力依赖用户定义的任务与划分。
SUP-griddly.en: Configurable games and observation modes support controlled generalization experiments. Different symbolic and rendered observers allow controlled observation/action studies.

SUP-elf.zh: MiniRTS 连接资源收集、单位生产及后续攻防；战争迷雾与侦察带来未知地域的信息获取问题。
SUP-elf.en: MiniRTS includes resource gathering, building units and attacking/defending. Fog-of-war and scouting expose unseen territories. Full-game training connects resource collection and troop production to later combat.

SUP-malmo.zh: 任务接口支持导航、生存、智能体间与人机合作；建造任务可组合移动、采掘与装配依赖，需具体定义目标。
SUP-malmo.en: Mission API supports navigation and survival scenarios. Platform supports AI-AI and human-AI collaboration tasks. Construction missions can combine navigation, mining and assembly dependencies.

SUP-spirebench.zh: 路线、卡组和战斗的后果跨多个时程；记忆关联依据跨局存储消融。
SUP-spirebench.en: Route, deck and combat choices have delayed consequences; cross-run memory is explicitly ablated.

SUP-pokeagent-challenge.zh: 对战中的隐藏状态与阵容变化对应策略和泛化；RPG 里程碑对应长时程规划。
SUP-pokeagent-challenge.en: Hidden state and varied teams probe strategy/generalization; RPG milestones probe long-horizon planning.

SUP-vgc-bench.zh: 未见阵容测试提供直接泛化证据，隐藏数值和同时行动构成策略挑战。
SUP-vgc-bench.en: Held-out teams directly test generalization; hidden stats and simultaneous actions require strategic reasoning.

SUP-gg-bench.zh: 新规则与多回合对抗用于观察规则迁移及连续策略决策。
SUP-gg-bench.en: Novel rules and multi-turn adversarial play probe transfer and sequential strategy.

SUP-comrad.zh: 合作目标与时空同步对应协作；独立留出布局对应泛化。
SUP-comrad.en: Shared objectives and temporal/spatial synchronization probe coordination; held-out layouts probe generalization.

SUP-agenticsts.zh: 显式移除记忆层提供记忆研究入口，整局策略决策带来长时程依赖。
SUP-agenticsts.en: Explicit memory-layer ablations support memory studies; full-run choices create long-horizon dependencies.

SUP-darefightingice-llm-2026.zh: 实时动作选择与对手应对符合控制和策略研究；不是 LLM 通用能力结论。
SUP-darefightingice-llm-2026.en: Real-time action selection and opponent response support control/strategy research, not general LLM capability claims.
